settings.grid: 49 weights of § 3 with both signs (98 points)
settings.null: first zero crossing going out from w = 0, linear in w
settings.width: |Tu| < 1/2 around the null, linear in w; ratio far/near and difference
settings.h5d_selection: frame against the truth for the machine beyond one SD of a; direction from the sign of the machine's within-class slope on a (test set)

H5a.rule: every pair crosses zero at a negative weight and median w0*k in [-1.1, -0.9]

H5b.rule: |Tu| at -1/k (k from one half, read on the other) has a median below 0.1

H5c.width: ratio far/near of the edges of |Tu| < 1/2, the convention of the band

as_difference.note: ln of a difference of weights changes sign around 1; reported, not used for the outcome

H5c.rule: median ln(measured width)/ln(predicted width) in [0.7, 1.3] and Spearman(phi, width) >= 0.7 over all the pairs

H5d.rule: where d_a(machine) < 0 with its interval, the signed turing crosses zero at a positive weight, and median w0 / (1/|k|) in [0.8, 1.25]

H5e.rule: median over pairs of mean |measured - predicted| / Tu_app on the extended grid below 0.10; Tu_app = sqrt(1 + k^2 - 2 k rho)/sin(phi), the peak of the Fano profile
